name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog:
Fixes uninstalling the plugin leaving Jellyfin with broken libraries. LibraryProvisioningService.RemoveAllAsync already existed specifically to remove auto-provisioned federation libraries (and detach federation media paths merged into a pre-existing user library) on uninstall - its own doc comment said so - but it was never actually called from Plugin.OnUninstalling, which only ever removed the federated items inside those libraries, not the library definitions themselves. Jellyfin's own post-uninstall cleanup then deletes this plugin's data folder - including the federation shadow folders those libraries pointed at - out from under a library definition that still referenced it, leaving a broken library pointing at a path that no longer exists. RemoveAllAsync is now actually called before that happens.

210 tests (unchanged).
